title: Amazon Linux 2 2017.12 - ALAS2-2026-4074: important priority package update for python-twisted-words
description:
Package updates are available for Amazon Linux 2 that fix the following vulnerabilities:
CVE-2026-115776:
	A flaw was found in Twisted. The Internet Relay Chat (IRC) protocol implementation does not enforce a maximum line length when buffering incoming connection data. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this by sending a continuous stream of data without line feed characters to an IRC service. This causes the server process to consume excessive memory until it runs out of resources, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) that terminates connections for all users.

CVE-2026-115775:
	A flaw was found in Twisted. An unauthenticated remote attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by exhausting server memory. The issue occurs because the XML stream parser retains unfinished elements in memory without enforcing size or element count limits. By transmitting a continuous stream of child elements within an unclosed container during pre-authentication communication, an attacker can crash the server process.
